verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents a first-party Gusto integration that syncs hiring, onboarding and equity data, so employee information does not need re-entry and new hires can flow into equity grants from offer-letter promises. The evidence covers only Gusto and only the new-hire direction. Missing for 10: evidence that terminations sync into equity records, support for other HRIS/payroll systems such as Rippling, detail on sync direction and frequency, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, stakeholders sync from my HRIS/payroll system (e.g. Gusto, Rippling) so new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically

citations.quote: Sync relevant hiring, onboarding, and equity data between Fidelity Private Shares and Gusto — no need for error-prone, duplicate data entry
eliminating the need to re-enter employee information in multiple solutions
Automatically grant equity from promises in offer letters
